Build kit for "AI Chat Conversation"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Matches the idea. Scaffold it, then replace its content. Keep its layout and spacing.

name:        ai-chat
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Transcript of alternating turns carrying mixed rich content inline (markdown, code blocks, collapsible tool-call output) beside a resizable artifact panel that holds generated output while the stream keeps scrolling.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template ai-chat --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        ai-chat-landing
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Zero-state entry surface centered on a single composer with suggestion chips instead of history, sized for the moment before any content exists.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template ai-chat-landing --type page <path>

name:        table-inbox
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Two-pane message queue: the table indexes a reading pane rather than being the destination, with a divider you drag to resize.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template table-inbox --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: ai-chat (@astryxdesign/core), ai-chat-landing (@astryxdesign/core), messaging-shell (@astryxdesign/core).
